_comment: Names that may appear in code, tests, and documentation.
Everything else named in game_data belongs to a live campaign and is
allowed only inside game_data/ and docs/docs_personal/. Writing a live
character into a test, a comment, a doc, or a test fixture in Drupal puts
someone's real campaign into the shared codebase, and a suggester that is
shown those names will keep proposing them.
Enforced by src/validation/example_world.py, run from check.sh.
Add a name here only when it belongs to the Example Campaign world.
